This '''Jedi''' was a member of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]] one year after the [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi Academy]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was founded.

==Biography==
In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], this Jedi, along with his fellow Jedi trainees, was taught in the ways of the Force by a Jedi trainer. He later helped [[Kyle Katarn]] and a [[Jedi Trainer|Jedi trainer]] fend of against [[Desann]]'s dark side minions. As a full-fledged Jedi Knight, this Jedi survived the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Empire Reborn)|battle]] on Yavin IV.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

This Jedi joined [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke's]] rank as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in the New Jedi Order by [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], and participated in the Jedi-lead [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|strike]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] that ended the threat posed by the [[Disciples of Ragnos]].<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

==Lightsaber==
[[File:JKA_jedi1.png|thumb|left|130px|The Jedi wields his Lightsaber.]]
This Jedi wielded a yellow-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a [[Retaliator (hilt)|Retaliator]]-style hilt.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi was introduced as a skin used by multiple [[Wikipedia:Non player character|NPCs]] in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'', but he was later treated as an individual character toward the end of [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast|the game]] and also throughout [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy|''Jedi Academy'']].

In ''Jedi Outcast'' the Jedi was voiced by [[Dominic Armato]], ''Jedi Academy'', by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

In ''Jedi Outcast'', the [[Strong style|lightsaber style]] that this Jedi used would indicate that he was a Jedi Knight towards the end of the game.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />
